invariants.rationale: The method returns immediately if a <= 0, so at exit, a must be > 0.
batch is used in method calls, so it must be non-null at all points after the early return.
r is likely a color channel and is set on batch via setColor(r, g, b, a), which expects color components in [0, 1].
g is a color channel for green and is likely restricted to [0, 1].
b is a color channel for blue and is likely restricted to [0, 1].
